scope_note: 动态发现的最多60款独立游戏样本：来自Steam美国区Indie热销/最近发行各前100条，至少有一个紧凑玩法标签，免费或美国区原价不高于25美元；排除DLC、软件、Demo和未发售作品。这些条件只是小体量的筛选代理，不代表已核实团队规模、制作预算或Steam全库排名。

sources.note: 按评论创建时间精确查询滚动窗口，所有语言与购买渠道，过滤离题活动。

sources.name: Steam 热销榜规则
sources.note: 近24小时收入、最近3小时加权，包含本体、DLC与内购，不是售出份数。

sources.name: Steam 当前在线人数
sources.note: 采集时连接Steam的正在游玩人数，不含离线玩家，也不是下载量。

sources.name: Steam 财务数据权限
sources.note: 实际日销量和收入需要对应发行商的财务权限，公开接口无法提供全库数据。

methodology: 动态发现的最多60款独立游戏样本：来自Steam美国区Indie热销/最近发行各前100条，至少有一个紧凑玩法标签，免费或美国区原价不高于25美元；排除DLC、软件、Demo和未发售作品。这些条件只是小体量的筛选代理，不代表已核实团队规模、制作预算或Steam全库排名。
候选按4款热销、1款最近发行轮流检查，符合规则后截取最多60款；所有排名仅在这一发现样本内比较。
近1/7/30天评价量按同一采集时点向前24/168/720小时，以评论创建时间统计；不是评论总数差值，也不是销量。
期间好评率=期间好评数/期间评价量；无评价时不计算比例。全部语言、全部购买渠道，过滤Steam离题评论活动。
当前热销为美国区Indie搜索榜顺位；全球榜位仅引用已核实全球来源的前100榜单，未入榜不视为0。
实时热销按近24小时收入并加权最近3小时，不能解释成纯24小时销量榜。没有公开滚动7/30天销量或下载榜。
商店资料缓存7天，本页数据每日采集、23小时内复用；失败保留旧值及原时间并标记过期，不把缺失写成0。
小游戏是本页筛选口径，Indie和低价本身不证明制作规模；玩法标签包括休闲、解谜、平台跳跃、Roguelite、卡牌、放置等。

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

games.name: Moon Sweepers
games.description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

games.name: Black King's Defense
games.description: Build a maze out of chess pieces and defend your king in this Tower Defense take on the timeless classic, Chess! Pawns, rooks, bishops, knights and queens strike by their own moves as the white army marches across a 3D board, through a full hand balanced campaign.

games.name: Dressmaker
games.description: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

games.name: Potato Please
games.description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

games.name: Thronefall
games.description: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.

games.name: クイズ！罵倒ネア！
games.description: This game is a quiz game that includes satire and jokes.

games.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
games.description: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.

games.name: Risk of Rain 2
games.description: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

games.name: Slay the Spire 2
games.description: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

games.name: Meow Dungeon: Idle Cat RPG
games.description: Build a party of pixel cats and let them auto-battle through 24 dungeons. They fight, loot and level up on their own, and keep adventuring even while the game is closed. Collect 14 breeds, hunt legendary gear and grow your cozy cat inn.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

games.name: Rejected Draft
games.description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

games.name: Spark Quest
games.description: Get ready for a race against the clock where you’ll control a team of bulbs with unique abilities! In each level, you’ll help these fragile bulbs overcome obstacles, rescue their companions, and finally light up in their sockets before time runs out.

games.name: Find The Needle
games.description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

games.name: Monster Train 2
games.description: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

games.name: Can 'Em All
games.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

games.name: Immortal Zenith: Idle to Ascension
games.description: An MMO idle cultivation RPG grounded in unique systems and intentional randomness. Your characters meditate, break through cultivation realms, explore, master powerful techniques, collect legendary treasures, and ascend from mortal to immortal.

games.name: Stardew Valley
games.description: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

games.name: Sunborn
games.description: A cosmic incremental about feeding a tiny spark until it goes SUPERNOVA. Drag fuel in yourself, let your colonies and their fleets haul it for you, or do both. Stack 158 upgrades, ram rogue planets, merge with dead stars and slingshot matter out of black holes.

games.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
games.description: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of movie and video game rentals!

games.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
games.description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

games.name: It Takes One To Gnome It All
games.description: Darkness is spreading through the forest, corrupting everything in its path. And somehow, it's up to you, a small regular gnome, to turn the tides. Fight against the odds and grow stronger while uncovering the secrets behind the corruption.

games.name: Farm & Feast
games.description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

games.name: BOMBANANA!
games.description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

games.name: Subjects of Cthullius
games.description: Explore a distant solar system in a sci-fi adventure where mathematics becomes a real superpower. Solve puzzles, complete missions, upgrade your mathemagical abilities, and uncover a mysterious conspiracy.

games.name: SONIC PICO PARK
games.description: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: over the hill
games.description: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover

games.name: Bio Party
games.description: Bio Party is a chaotic 2–4 player party game packed with fast-paced minigames, ridiculous physics, and plenty of ways to sabotage your friends. Compete, cooperate, betray, and survive a series of unpredictable biological challenges.

games.name: Tabletop Simulator
games.description: Tabletop Simulator is the only simulator where you can let your aggression out by flipping the table! There are no rules to follow: just you, a physics sandbox, and your friends. Make your own online board games or play the thousands of community created mods. Unlimited gaming possibilities!

games.name: Safari-TV
games.description: Run a safari agency with friends in chaotic 2–4 player co-op. Drive a fully destructible, physics-based truck, take care of tourists, and survive wildlife encounters. Film the chaos, watch your videos together, and grow your in-game channel.

games.name: Astral Party
games.description: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.

games.name: Brawlhalla
games.description: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or local. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android & Steam! Frequent updates. Over sixty Legends.

games.name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
games.description: The Saurian Alliance is threatened by The Theropod Empire. That's scary. Our heroes, a ragtag group of dinosaurs from all walks of life (and one that is definitely not a Corgi-Iguanodon hybrid), must band together to fight back against the dark side of The Moon(tm).

games.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
games.description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Go Next!
games.description: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: RV There Yet?
games.description: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

games.name: Terraria
games.description: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

games.name: Escape the Backrooms
games.description: Escape the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Traverse 30+ eerie backrooms levels while avoiding entities and other dangers. Try to escape but be warned: survival isn't guaranteed.

games.name: Timepaths
games.description: Time is the most valuable resource. Use it wisely to play cards that give you resources that you need to build timepaths. Complete the timepath before you run out of time. Featuring an adventure mode, card editor, and infinite levels.

games.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
games.description: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

games.name: Tape to Tape
games.description: Tape to Tape is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

games.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021
games.description: Work your way to a service empire. Get your hands dirty in a highly realistic simulation game that pays major attention to details. Pay a visit to a new Auction house and buy cars in various conditions. Expand your range of services by investing in a new work space and equipment.

games.name: Scared Numbers
games.description: They have survival instincts. They have anxiety. They are terrified of your cursor. Hunt them down, exploit their herd mentality, and feed them into the shredder. It's mission-critical math in a world where nothing matters.

games.name: Finals Week ✍🏻
games.description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: The Motel
games.description: Episodic first-person psychological horror. Explore a sinister motel as two brothers and solve puzzles. The current release contains only the pilot episode; later story episodes are planned as major updates included with your purchase at no extra charge.

games.name: What the Buck?!
games.description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

games.name: Oboro no Ichi
games.description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

games.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
games.description: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

games.name: Leaf it Alone
games.description: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

games.name: Vast Mines
games.description: A simple but addictive isometric mining game, get upgrades, forge pickaxes, and travel deeper into the mines.

games.name: Absolum
games.description: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.description: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

games.name: Balatro
games.description: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

games.name: Crush Crush
games.description: Welcome to Crush Crush - the Idle Dating Sim! Meet, flirt, and fall in love with a motley cast of girls in this heartfelt and hilarious game.

games.name: One Million Coins
games.description: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.
